text:
Maya (CEO): Quick exec weekly — short and specific. Highlights + 3 actions.

Maya (CEO): Highlights: we closed Q1 at $12.3M ARR (net new ARR ahead of plan). Big thanks to growth + infra teams :tada:. Dedicated capacity pilot customers onboarded this week.

Maya (CEO): Operational note: rolling out a change to request-log retention across Hosted: default retention will move from 90 -> 30 days on Mon 2026-05-11. This is to reduce storage cost and limit retention risk for customer data. Private deployments will not be forced; they'll get an opt-in config and docs.

Maya (CEO): SLOs: overall 99.9% p99 target holding, but we saw a small spike in token-cost last 2 weeks tied to long-context embeddings batch jobs. Priya + Evan, please prioritize an action plan to throttle or isolate those queues.

Maya (CEO): 3 asks (please):
- Evan: confirm Dedicated v1.0 launch rollout plan and post the phased rollout timeline in the product-runbook by EOD Thu.
- Priya: send a short runbook for the retention switch (rollback steps + communication text) by Fri morning.
- Luca: update finance with modeled savings from retention change and the expected cadence for reporting (monthly).

Maya (CEO): I'll run a 20-min sync Friday 09:30 PT to sign off on open items. If you can't make it, drop a one-line status in this thread.

Evan (VP Product): Ack — will post rollout timeline today. Quick note: Dedicated v1.0 will launch with canary customers first (10% traffic), then 50% next day, full by day 3 if metrics OK. Adding a cost-metering flag in the API to track per-tenant qps/cost.

Priya (Head of Eng): On it. Retention switch runbook draft incoming in ~6 hours. Throttle plan: create a low-priority queue and cap embeddings batch size to 4 for non-SLAd customers. Will include monitoring alerts for cost delta > 15%.

Luca (Head of Finance): Thanks — I'll run the savings model and post numbers in the finance-docs link. Expect ~18% reduction in storage/NLU infra costs at steady state. Also: please note hiring update — recruiting for two infra SREs cleared for Q2 spend.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Hosted retention change -> 2026-05-11 02:00 UTC. Rollback window: 4 hours.

Maya (CEO): Appreciated. If anything blocks the rollout (legal/compliance flags), @Priya escalate to legal immediately. Otherwise see you Friday. :v:
